DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 券の使い方についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is your question about how to use the tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この券で、あのゲームをもう一回できますか。入口に入れようとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 券を機械へ入れて使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Can I play that game one more time with this ticket? I was about to put it into the slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the ticket by inserting it into the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ機械へ入れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You haven't put it into the machine yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。券の大きさは合いそうでしたが、説明を読んでいないので止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: まだ投入していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: No. It looked as though it would fit, but I stopped because I hadn't read the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Answer that you have not inserted it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: これは景品の引換券です。ゲームの利用券ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is a prize redemption ticket. It is not a ticket for playing the game.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 引換と書いてありますね。この枚数を持って景品の窓口へ行く物なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 景品用の券と利用券を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It does say ‘redemption.’ So I take the tickets I have to the prize counter, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Read the labels to distinguish prize tickets from game tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手持ちの枚数で選べる物を、こちらで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can check here what prizes you can choose with the number of tickets you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 五枚あります。もっと遊んで増やすより、今の五枚で選べる物を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手持ち枚数で選べる景品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have five. Rather than play more to get more tickets, I'd like to see what I can choose with these five.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask which prizes you can choose with your current number of tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この欄が五枚の景品です。お好きな物をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: This section shows the prizes for five tickets. Please choose whichever you like.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: この小さいノートへ交換します。ゲームには入れず、五枚全部をこちらへ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 追加プレイせず手持ち券で交換する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll exchange them for this small notebook. I won't put them in the game; I'll give you all five here.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Exchange the tickets you have without playing again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 五枚でノートをお渡しします。お受取りの品と券の枚数を確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here is your notebook for five tickets. I've checked the item you're receiving and the number of tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 駐輪区画についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like advice about a bicycle parking space?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 空いていた所へ止めましたが、戻って表示を見ると定期利用の区画でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 空き所へ止めたが定期表示に気付いたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I parked in an empty space, but when I came back and looked at the sign, I realized it was for season pass holders.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that you parked in an empty space and then noticed the season pass sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いつ入れましたか。お支払いは済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: When did you park? Have you paid yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。まだ払っていません。一時利用だと思って、区画の表示を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 入庫時刻と未精算を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: About ten minutes ago. I haven't paid yet. I thought it was for short-term parking and didn't check the space's sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State when you parked and that you have not paid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらで現状を確認して、移動の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll check the current situation and explain how to move your bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自分で隣へ動かす前に確認したいです。一時利用の所へ直してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勝手に別区画へ移す前に取扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to check before moving it to the next space myself. Could you help me put it in a short-term space instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what to do before moving to a different space without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 管理人が確認しました。案内する二十四番へお移しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The attendant has checked. Please move it to space twenty-four, as directed.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二十四番ですね。入口の一時利用の表示も見て、そこへ止め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 案内された一時区画の番号を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Number twenty-four, right? I'll also check the short-term parking sign at the entrance and park it there instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Repeat the number of the short-term space you were directed to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 移動後は、実際に止めた区画の番号で精算してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: After moving it, please pay using the number of the space where you actually parked.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 移しました。古い区画番号ではなく、二十四番の案内で帰る時に払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 移動後の正しい区画で精算すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've moved it. When I leave, I'll pay according to the instructions for number twenty-four, rather than the old space number.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will pay for the correct space after moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 一時利用の二十四番へ移動したことを確認しました。控えの番号も合わせてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've confirmed that you moved to short-term space twenty-four. Please make sure the number on your slip matches as well, and keep it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 返却資料の確認をしています。別冊付録はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm checking the items you're returning. Do you have the separate supplement?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい冊子がありましたが、本文から外れたページと思って、自分のノートへ挟みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 返却本に付録が足りないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: There was a small booklet, but I thought it was pages that had come loose from the main book and put it inside my own notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether a supplement is missing from the book you are returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 資料に付属する物です。今、お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: It belongs with the library item. Do you have it with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありました。ノートに入っています。捨てたり、書き込んだりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 持帰った小冊子を本の一部と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I found it. It's in my notebook. I haven't thrown it away or written in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the booklet you took home was part of the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらへ一緒にお出しください。資料との対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please hand it over with the book. I'll check which item it belongs to.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この冊子です。別の本の間に入れて返さず、どの本に付く物か確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手元で見つけた付録を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's this booklet. Please check which book it goes with, rather than putting it inside a different book when returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the supplement you found among your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表紙の番号が、この本の付録番号と一致しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The number on the cover matches the supplement number for this book.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ一組と確認できましたね。次に借りる時は、本と別冊が何点あるかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 別の本へ返却されないよう対応番号の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: So we've confirmed that they're one set. Next time I borrow something, I'll also check how many books and separate supplements there are.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the matching numbers so the supplement is not returned with a different book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今回は本と付録をそろえて返却として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll accept the book and supplement together as your return this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、この一組で返却をお願いします。自分のノートには図書館の物が残っていないと確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 本と付録一組で返却を完了する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please process this set as returned, then. I've checked that there are no library items left in my own notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Complete the return of the book and supplement as one set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 本と付録の返却を確認しました。ノートはお手元へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've confirmed the return of both the book and supplement. Please take your notebook back.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お薬の袋のお名前をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please check the names on the medicine bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私と家族の二人分です。袋を並べ替えたので、説明をどちらの物として聞くか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分と家族の二袋の説明を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are two people's medicines, mine and my family member's. I rearranged the bags, and now I'm unsure which person's medicine the explanation is for.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the explanations for your medicine bag and your family member's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お名前を一袋ずつ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's check the name on each bag one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この名前が私で、こちらが家族です。同じ形の袋だからと一つの説明にまとめません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 袋を混ぜて並べたと伝え氏名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This name is mine, and this one is my family member's. I won't treat the explanations as one just because the bags look the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you mixed up the order of the bags and show the names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まずご本人の分を説明します。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。私の袋と説明書だけをここへ置き、飲み方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の用法だけ先に説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I'd like to put only my bag and instruction sheet here and check how to take my medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of only your own dosage instructions first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご本人分はこちらの説明です。ご家族の分については受取と説明の方法を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: These are the instructions for your medicine. The person in charge will check how to handle collection and the explanation for your family member's medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家族の飲み方を私の分と同じと思わず、本人へどう説明するかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家族分は本人への説明方法を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't assume my family member should take theirs the same way as mine. I'd also like advice about how to explain it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check with the person in charge how to explain your family member's medicine to them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。今の説明で分からない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll pass that request on. Is there anything you don't understand in the explanation so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 私の分は確認できました。二人の名前で袋を分け、家族分の説明は担当の案内で進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 二袋を名前で分け本人分の確認を終える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've checked my own medicine. I'll separate the bags by our names and follow the person's guidance for the explanation of my family member's medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Separate the two bags by name and finish checking your own medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ご本人分の説明を終えました。ご家族の分は、別の説明として担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: We've finished explaining your medicine. I'll refer you to the person in charge for a separate explanation of your family member's medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通帳の記帳はお済みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。入金の横の空いた所へ、何のお金か自分で書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 通帳の取引横へ用途を書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. May I write what a deposit was for in the blank space beside it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write the purpose beside a bankbook transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どんな用途を分けたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: What types of payments would you like to distinguish?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 給与と家族からの送金です。表示の名前だけでは、後で見た時に分からなくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 給与と家族送金を見分けたい理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Salary and transfers from my family. If I only look at the names printed there, I won't know which is which later.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to distinguish salary from family transfers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 銀行が印字した内容の訂正をご希望ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So you are not asking to correct what the bank printed, are you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 訂正ではなく自分のメモです。印字の所を変えず、別紙で管理する方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 銀行印字を変える希望ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: No, it's a note for myself, not a correction. Would it be better to keep it on a separate sheet without changing the printed entries?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that you do not want to change the bank's printed entries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通帳の記録はそのまま残し、ご自身の用途メモと分けて保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can leave the bankbook record as it is and keep your personal notes about purposes separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 日付と金額を別紙へ写して、分かる入金の理由を添えます。不明な物は、理由を決めず確認中と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 日付と金額で別紙を対応させたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll copy the dates and amounts onto a separate sheet and add the reasons for deposits I recognize. For anything unknown, I'll write ‘being checked’ rather than decide on a reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you want to match a separate sheet to the transactions by date and amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 必要な取引の確認は、正式な記録を示してお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: If you need to check any transaction, please ask us with the official record.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 通帳には書き込まず、別紙を同じ日付と金額で対応させます。家族にも、送った日を確認して整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 原通帳を保ち自分用メモで整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I won't write in the bankbook. I'll match the separate sheet using the same dates and amounts. I'll also check with my family when they sent the money as I organize it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Preserve the original bankbook and organize the information in personal notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 通帳はこちらへお返しします。用途のメモは、ご本人の管理資料として区別してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here is your bankbook back. Please keep your notes on payment purposes clearly separate as your own management records.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入場口をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the entrance?

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券の十二番へ来たつもりですが、ここには入口がありません。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号の入口が見つからないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd come to number twelve as shown on my ticket, but there's no entrance here.
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask because you cannot find the entrance with that number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十二は、券のどの欄にありますか。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which section of your ticket has the number twelve?

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席番の所でした。大きい数字だけ見て、ゲートも十二番と思いました。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券の数字をゲートと思ったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the seat number. I only looked at the large number and thought the gate was twelve as well.
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you mistook a number on the ticket for the gate number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ゲートはこちらの欄、座席はその隣です。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: The gate is in this section, and the seat is next to it.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ゲートは三番、席は十二番ですね。同じ番号で探す物ではないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ゲート欄と座席欄を別に読み返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: The gate is three, and the seat is twelve, right? Now I understand that I shouldn't look for both using the same number.
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read back the gate section and seat section separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三番ゲートへは外側の通路をお進みください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow the outer walkway to gate three.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者にも十二番で会うと伝えていました。三番ゲートへ訂正してから、この通路で向かいます。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ入口訂正を伝え近い道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also told the person coming with me to meet at number twelve. I'll correct that to gate three, then head there along this walkway.
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion the correct entrance and ask for a nearby route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三番の表示が見えたら、入場券を準備してください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you see the sign for number three, please have your ticket ready.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡できました。券を持ち、三番で同行者と会ってから入ります。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券を持ち正しいゲートで合流する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've contacted them. I'll take my ticket, meet them at gate three, and then go in.
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take your ticket and meet at the correct gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの通路から三番へお進みください。席は入場後、券の席番でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow this walkway to number three. Once inside, check your seat using the seat number on your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらのカードへチャージでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Would you like to top up this card?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。千円入れたいです。朝から残高が足りないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 提示カードへチャージを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I'd like to add a thousand yen. I've thought since this morning that the balance was too low.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to top up the card you have presented. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 記名のあるカードですね。お名前を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: This card has a registered name. Please check the name.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: これは家族の名前です。財布に二枚あり、私の方だと思って出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 記名を見て家族のカードと気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: That's my family member's name. There were two cards in my wallet, and I took this out thinking it was mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Read the name and realize it is your family member's card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: まだ入金していません。必要なカードをお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: We haven't added any money yet. Please show me the card you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらが私のです。この一枚の残高を見て、千円で足りるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 自分のカードを出し残高照会を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: This one is mine. I'd like to see the balance on this card and check whether adding a thousand yen will be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Present your own card and ask to check its balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 表示はこちらです。チャージの金額をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: The balance is displayed here. Please tell me how much you want to add.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 私のカードだけ千円お願いします。家族の方は残高も分からないので、今日は入金しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 必要な一枚だけへ入金すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Please add a thousand yen to just my card. I don't know the balance on my family member's card, so I won't add anything to it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you will add money only to the one card you need. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご本人のカードへ千円を入れました。表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I've added a thousand yen to your card. Please check the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 残高を確認しました。私のカードを受け取り、家族の一枚とは財布の場所を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本人カードの残高と受取を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I've checked the balance. I'll take my card back and keep it in a different part of my wallet from my family member's.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm the balance on your own card and that you have received it back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お渡ししたカードをご確認ください。もう一枚も、お忘れなくお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Please check the card I've returned. Remember to take the other card as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お探しの本は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Did you find the book you were looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 題名は合っていますが、友人が言った五十ページに同じ問題がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人の指定ページがないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: The title is right, but page fifty doesn't have the same exercise my friend mentioned.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the page your friend specified does not contain the expected material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 版や発行年は確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Have you checked the edition and publication year?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 題名だけを見ました。友人の写真には第三版、ここは第四版とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 本の題名は同じで版を未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I only checked the title. My friend's photo says third edition, but this one says fourth edition.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that the title is the same but you had not checked the edition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 版が変わると、内容やページの配置も変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: When the edition changes, the content and page layout can change too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 第三版の在庫はありますか。なければ、新版のどこに同じ範囲があるか分かる資料が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人の表紙写真と版表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Do you have the third edition in stock? If not, I'd like information showing where the same material is in the new edition.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Compare your friend's cover photo with the edition printed on the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 旧版の在庫と出版社の案内を確認します。こちらには対応表がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll check the stock of the old edition and the publisher's information. We don't have a correspondence table here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: では友人に、第四版でも授業に使えるか聞きます。ページだけで同じ本と伝えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 旧版在庫と新版対応表の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Then I'll ask my friend whether the fourth edition can be used in class too. I'll avoid saying it's the same book based only on the page number.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask about stock of the old edition and a correspondence table for the new edition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 確認してからお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: You can decide after you've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日は買わず、題名と第四版の表示を控えます。友人の返事を聞いてから選びに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人へ版の違いを確認して購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I won't buy it today. I'll note the title and the fourth-edition label, then come back to choose after hearing from my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the edition difference with your friend and postpone your purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 本はこちらで棚へ戻します。控えた題名と版で、次回もお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll put the book back on the shelf. Next time, you can ask us using the title and edition you've noted.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ラーメンと、ご飯を一緒にお出ししますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll bring your ramen and rice together.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご飯だけ後にしていただけますか。麺を先に食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 追加ご飯を後に出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Could you bring just the rice later? I'd like to eat the noodles first.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether the additional rice can be served later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ラーメンのご注文も変更されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Would you like to change your ramen order as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ラーメンはそのままでお願いします。もう作っていただいている物を止めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: ラーメンは今の注文を維持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Please leave the ramen order as it is. I don't want you to stop preparing something you've already started.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the current ramen order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご飯は、どの時点でお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: At what point would you like us to bring the rice?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 麺を食べ終わった頃に、私から声を掛けます。残したスープと一緒に食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 後にする理由と希望する声掛けを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll call you when I've finished the noodles. I'd like to eat the rice with the soup I've left.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain why you want the rice later and how you will signal for it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その合図でお持ちします。ご飯の大きさは小のままですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll bring it when you call us. You still want the small rice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。量は小で、変更したいのは出す順番だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 提供順だけの変更で量は同じと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, the small portion. The only change I want is the order in which you serve them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm that only the serving order is changing and the amount remains the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。先にラーメンをお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Understood. We'll bring the ramen first.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 麺を先にいただき、ご飯が必要になったら声を掛けます。ご飯を忘れたと思って、もう一度注文しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 麺を先に食べご飯は合図で頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll eat the noodles first and call when I need the rice. I won't assume you've forgotten it and order it a second time.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Eat the noodles first and call for the rice when ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご飯は注文に残したまま、合図をお待ちします。まずラーメンをお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll keep the rice on your order and wait for your signal. Please enjoy the ramen first.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この後のご案内で、不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Is there anything unclear about what you should do next?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会計の紙と、松葉杖の練習場所の紙があります。どちらへ先に行くか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 会計と杖練習の二案内の順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I have a paper for payment and another showing where to practice with crutches. I don't know which place to go to first.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask which comes first, payment or crutch practice, as you have instructions for both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 診察で受けた案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Let's check the instructions you received during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 医師からは歩き方を教わるよう言われました。受付では会計の番号も受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 医師説明と受付指示を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: The doctor told me to learn how to walk with them. Reception also gave me a payment number.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish the doctor's explanation from the reception instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 担当へ順番を確認します。杖は使ったことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll check the order with the person in charge. Have you used crutches before?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありません。会計へ急いで歩く前に、使い方を教わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 杖をまだ使ったことがないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: No. I'd like someone to show me how to use them before I hurry over to the payment counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that you have never used crutches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 先に指導を受ける案内になっています。会計の窓口にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: The instructions are for you to receive training first. I'll let the payment counter know too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同行者には、会計の順番の様子を見て待ってもらいます。私の代わりに支払うかは、まだ決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 先に練習し同行者へ会計待機を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll ask the person with me to watch the payment queue and wait. We haven't decided yet whether they'll pay on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Receive crutch training first and ask your companion to wait by the payment counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 支払方法は練習後に受付へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: You can discuss how to pay with reception after the training.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 先に指導を受け、終わったら同行者と会計へ行きます。この二枚は両方持って移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 指導後に本人が会計する段取りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll get the training first, then go to the payment counter with my companion. I'll take both papers with me when I move.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will go to pay yourself after the training. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その順番でお進みください。移動の支援が必要な際は、ここで職員へお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-TOKOROZAWA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Please follow that order. If you need help moving, ask a staff member here.
